text: 2.1 Mark Well, I'm not normally a nervous person, so I felt pretty relaxed about the whole thing. And I've always got on well with people, so I didn't expect there to be a problem. But things started going wrong from the moment I turned up. I was wearing jeans and a shirt, but the restaurant was a really elegant place. Her mum was in a silk dress and her dad in a smart suit. I was really fed up with Annie that she hadn't warned me it was a formal dinner. Anyway, I tried to make conversation, but I kept getting confused when anyone asked me a question. Then I told a couple of jokes and no one laughed. The silence was awful. said her parents didn't mind, but it was a relief when the evening was over.
